preconditions.description: The number of denominations n is between 2 and 100.
Denominations are strictly increasing and each is less than or equal to 10^6.

postconditions.expression: if return_value == 'canonical': all(min_coins_greedy(x) == min_coins_optimal(x) for x in range(1, sum_of_two_largest_denominations))
postconditions.description: If the coin system is canonical, the greedy algorithm yields the optimal number of coins for all amounts less than the sum of the two largest denominations.

postconditions.expression: if return_value == 'non-canonical': any(min_coins_greedy(x) > min_coins_optimal(x) for x in range(1, sum_of_two_largest_denominations))
postconditions.description: If the coin system is non-canonical, there exists at least one amount for which the greedy algorithm uses more coins than the optimal solution.
